caption: The drawing shows a metal trivet or stand with four bent legs and a decorative, openwork top surface. The top is a mix of circular and slotted brass with a starburst pattern in the center and parallel slits to one side. At one end, there is a turned wooden handle in a dark brown color attached firmly to the brass top. The four metal legs are gray and each is shaped with right angles and outward flares, set at varying angles for balance, with curled ends for additional stability or stylistic effect. The drawing is rendered on a plain, light beige background, and the colors of the depicted objects are mostly muted metallic tones with the bronze-like brass top and iron-like gray legs.
title: Trivet
